candidates.counter_evidence_explanation: Gateway, order and payment metrics show low error rates and p95 76 ms, so the alert-level impact is not corroborated at those tiers; only inventory metrics and one trace show the fault.
missing_evidence: Inventory logs showing configuration rejection messages and their cause
Inventory traces for the failing calls to confirm error origin and latency
Inventory configuration change/deployment record for the window
candidates.statement: Inventory shows 21 configuration_rejections and error_rate 0.15 while other services are healthy; gateway traces show an ERROR span calling inventory (2017 ms). This supports a bad-configuration fault at inventory as the bounded root-cause candidate for the checkout error/latency alert.
candidates.uncertainty: Only one error trace and aggregate inventory metrics are available; the specific misconfigured setting is not identified.

report.explanation: Inventory is the only service with elevated error rate (0.15) and 21 configuration_rejections, and a gateway trace shows an ERROR calling inventory at 2017 ms. Other services report healthy metrics. Bounded candidate: bad-configuration at inventory; specific setting and logs still required.
